title: Console Audit Viewer: advanced search, export controls, and saved views
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Build a production-grade audit log viewer in the Console that supports expressive search, durable saved views, and secure export flows. This ticket captures the work to add: advanced filtering (actor, action, resource, IP, SSO session id, time ranges), pagination that works with large result sets, CSV/JSON export with retention-aware limits, saved queries with shareable permissions, and RBAC V2 integration so only authorized roles can view/export. The feature must integrate with existing audit ingestion and respect retention/legal-hold flags. Deliverables: UI, backend query API, export job service, saved-view management endpoints, and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI allows composing queries with filters: actor, action, resource type, resource id, status, IP, SAML/SSO session id, request_id, and time range
Search results are paginated with stable cursors; deep paging must not degrade cluster performance
Exports (CSV/JSON) can be requested for any saved query or ad-hoc query; exports larger than 100k rows are handled as background jobs with email/console notification
Export permission enforced by RBAC V2: only roles with 'audit:export' may download full exports; 'audit:view' grants in-console view but disables export
Saved views can be created, named, described, and shared with teams or specific users; sharing respects RBAC and tenant boundaries
Export respects retention and legal-hold: when retention prevents full export, the UI surfaces which rows were omitted and export format signals truncation
Backend exposes an export job API with job status, streaming download URL (S3 pre-signed), and audit entry for every export action
Automated tests cover query correctness, RBAC checks, and export size/timeout edge cases
Documentation and runbook updated: how to troubleshoot export jobs and how to enable auditor roles in RBAC V2
updates: 2025-02-12: Ticket created after security offsite. PM aligned on scope: exports must be auditable and safe for enterprise customers.
2025-02-15: Spike completed; validated that current ES cluster can support cursor-based pagination for up to 500k results with query rewrite. Prototype branch: github.com/redwood-inference/prs/4321
2025-02-18: Design review with Liz (Design) — initial mockups include column selector and timezone normalization dropdown. Design feedback recorded in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz/audit-exports
2025-02-20: Security review scheduled; SSO context (SAML attributes) to be included in default audit schema. Need decision on anonymization for IP addresses (partial redaction versus hashed).
2025-02-22: Miguel pushed a draft API spec for export jobs. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AUDIT/Export+Job+API
2025-02-24: PM requested soft limit of 10M rows for exports and hard time window of 90 days for non-admins; admins can request exports up to retention limit. Added to acceptance criteria.
design_feedback: Column selector should default to a curated set for enterprise tenants (actor, action, time, resource, request_id)
Include a timezone selector and show timestamps in tenant local timezone by default
Saved queries UI should show owner and last-run time and allow cloning
For large exports show progress UI tied to background job with cancel option
engineering_notes: Query backend: implement cursor-based stable pagination (opaque next_cursor) to avoid costly deep offsets
Export backend: background worker with chunked reads -> stream to S3, write manifest and pre-signed URL for download
Use row-level RBAC checks when compiling export to enforce tenant/role boundaries
Add an export_audit_log entry for each export action recording initiator, query hash, result count, S3 URL (redacted in UI), and retention truncation flag
Performance target: first-page latency < 300ms p95 for 30-day queries; export throughput target 50k rows/min per worker
Edge case: if retention deletes rows mid-export, mark job status as 'partial' and include omitted_ranges in manifest (text field), notify security team
Rate limiting: exports queued by tenant with concurrency quota; non-admins limited to 1 concurrent export
Testing: add integration tests using a seeded dataset and a synthetic retention policy to verify partial exports
qa_plan: Functional tests for search filters across actor/action/resource combinations
Simulate large result set and validate cursor stability across pages
Export job tests: success, partial (retention), cancel, fail and retry
RBAC tests: user with audit:view only cannot download export; auditor role can
E2E test for saved views create/share/clone flows
rollout_notes: Phase 1: Internal beta (company tenants only) with export size cap 100k rows; monitor job latency and error rate
Phase 2: Gradual rollout to customers with opt-in audit export; enable RBAC V2 auditor role mapping guidance in docs
Emergency kill-switch: admin toggle in Console to disable exports per-organization if abuse or performance issues observed
Post-rollout: run 2-week audit on export job logs to ensure no unauthorized exports occurred
